summary: Implemented the rich.progress open and wrap_file feature (module-level and Progress methods, private reader and context wrapper) in rich/progress.py, added tests to tests/test_progress.py before the __main__ block, added docs subsections in docs/source/progress.rst, and added a CHANGELOG.md Unreleased Added entry linking PR 1759. The diff is additive only (805 insertions, 0 deletions). Nothing was run: no tests, black, or mypy, per the instructions, so the new code and tests are unverified. Choices: io.open is used for the byte handle to avoid the module-level open shadowing the builtin; text versus binary is decided by the raw mode string, so 'tr' validates but returns binary as the spec says; the reader's handle is typed Any because BinaryIO lacks readinto. Caveat: the module-level context opens the file at call time, so a caller who never enters the context leaks the handle, as the spec requires. Changes are uncommitted.
